probes.name: read_range_omits_bounds
probes.original: Require 0 <= start <= end <= sequence length; otherwise error.value.out_of_range. Return the same representation family containing exactly positions start through end-1; equal bounds produce the corresponding empty value. No clipping or ambient encoding conversion occurs. An incompatible unit/representation or wrong key/type uses error.operation.parameter.
matched_violations: read range omits 0 <= start <= end <= sequence length

probes.name: optional_validation_never_scheduled
probes.original: Every selected and applicable VALIDATE is evaluated before any effect. REQUIRED controls whether a FALSE result blocks, not whether a selected check runs. VERIFY follows its actually activated producers or observed targets. A TEST root executes only its explicit TASK or ACTION, if present, then evaluates ASSERT or EXPECTED/ACTUAL. Where WHEN exists, absence means TRUE and FALSE skips applicability. A skipped check has no result; an explicit required read of that absent result uses ordinary MISSING behavior, never implicit TRUE. Required demanded MISSING and UNKNOWN use error.required.missing and error.value.unknown. No WHEN field is invented for TEST.
matched_violations: check demand omits Every selected and applicable VALIDATE

probes.name: candidate_only_verify_target
probes.original: Select VALIDATE, VERIFY, and FAILURE declarations in the EXECUTE root source document. A targetless clause applies to that invocation. For pre-effect VALIDATE, a resolved TARGET must name a candidate graph member, a data/output declaration explicitly referenced by that graph, or the exact material/address TARGET selected by a graph ACTION. Match declaration identity or material identity under types_v0.1.0.json#/material_identity_contract; never expand ambient resources. Targeted post-execution VERIFY applies only to an actually activated producer or an observed target of that invocation, not an unselected IF branch merely present in the candidate graph. Include check prerequisites explicitly referenced by selected checks or the root SUCCESS. Unrelated imported checks never run merely because their document was imported. TEST declarations are activated only as an explicit TEST root or operation target, never as ambient tasks.
probes.expected_detection: check target selection omits actually activated
matched_violations: check target selection omits actually activated
